sources_used: web search (Portugal/Poland/Puerto Rico/Russia arcade rhythm games)

findings.name: Salon Lider (Wybrzeże 2)
findings.evidence_quote: Seasonal arcade; listed cabs ATV Track, Daytona USA 2, OutRun 2, Time Crisis 4. Mostly ticket/redemption; no music games listed.
findings.note: Seasonal Łeba seaside site; ZIv 2023 inventory is racing/shooter only. No rhythm cabs listed.

findings.name: Tawerna Rybacka
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Tekken 2 Ver.B only (fighter, universal cabinet near entrance).
findings.note: Single fighting cab; no rhythm/music machines on ZIv.

findings.name: Top Net Games
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: StepMania Converted Cabinet (International). Stepmania machine on a holiday campsite park. Open seasonally! Best times May - August.
findings.note: Only ZIv entry is 2013; seasonal campsite. Map as stepmaniax (StepMania 4-panel software). Current presence unverified after 12+ years.

findings.name: Bowling City - Centro Comercial Colombo
findings.evidence_quote: Listed: Let's Go Jungle, Operation G.H.O.S.T., Rabbids Hollywood, Ball Runner, Down The Clown, Fruit Ninja FX, Sonic Dash Extreme, Virtual Rabbids; no music games.
findings.note: Bowling/redemption/rail-shooter lineup only. Inventory dated 2020; lineup may rotate but no rhythm evidence found.

findings.name: Bowling Setúbal
findings.evidence_quote: Bowling alley with arcade machines, snooker, table tennis and lazer tag. Cabs: Monster Bash pinball, Daytona USA, MotoGP, Terminator Salvation, Time Crisis II, basketball, boxing, pool; no music games.
findings.note: Recent ZIv full inventory: racing/shooter/sports only.

findings.name: Cidade das Brincadeiras - B Planet
findings.evidence_quote: Mini arcade beside food court. Games: Daytona Championship USA, E-Claw 7000, Ice Man, Fast Track.
findings.note: Kids mini-arcade; racing/claw only.

findings.name: Cinema City - Campo Pequeno
findings.evidence_quote: Little arcade next to Cinema City: Pandora's Box DX/Ultra, Console in a Cab, claws, boxing, Fast Track, foosball, hockey tables; full Pandora game list is classic/fighting, no pad rhythm.
findings.note: Cinema lobby multicades and redemption; no dedicated music game cabs.

findings.name: Diver Jump Trampoline Park
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Initial D The Arcade only (Cortesia da BIP DIVERSÕES).
findings.note: Trampoline park with single racing cab; no rhythm.

findings.name: Funny Farm Vilamoura
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Hit Music (International) Perfect €1.00. Also Race Craft, claws, basketball, boxing. Warning: machines may rotate.
findings.note: Hit Music filed under Music Game on ZIv; not a Konami/Sega/Andamiro title so slug other. Fleet rotates.

findings.name: Joker Lounge
findings.evidence_quote: Try our arcade machines (table football, pinball, air hockey, darts) taking you back to the past while enjoying our food and drinks. Also bowling and snooker on site.
findings.note: Official site + ZIv list only Stern pinballs (Iron Maiden, James Bond, John Wick, Star Wars). No rhythm machines.

findings.name: Level Up | Arcade Lounge And Bar
findings.evidence_quote: Pinball (Indiana Jones, Medieval Madness), Daytona Championship USA, Sega Rally 3, Storm Racer G, Storm Rider, Time Crisis 5, claw, basketball, boxing, darts, pool; no music games.
findings.note: Caparica arcade bar; full 2025 inventory has no rhythm/music cabs.

findings.name: Lockers & Games
findings.evidence_quote: Arcade bar lounge has Guns n Roses themed pinballs, The Getaway High Speed, Popeye, The Shadow, NBA Fastbreak. FB: 5 pinballs, claw, multicade with thousands of games, air hockey, darts, punch machine.
findings.note: Porto pinball/game bar. No dedicated rhythm pad cabs in listings; multicade is generic, not pad DDR.

findings.name: Salão De Jogos | Bar • Desporto
findings.evidence_quote: Small game room with an arcade and pool tables. Games: Scud Race, Pool Table.
findings.note: Almada sports bar; racing + pool only.

findings.name: Aguadilla Shark Roller Rink
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: StepMania Converted Cabinet. Custom built cabinet housing with genuine arcade pads and DDR branding. Originally running DDR A3, it now uses a Simply Love theme.
findings.note: Fresh 2026 ZIv update: pad cab on StepMania/Simply Love (was DDR A3). Slug stepmaniax for StepMania pad software.

findings.name: Caribbean Cinemas (Dorado - Paseo del Plata Shopping Center)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Neon FM (North America). To the right once you enter the arcade. Decent volume. Stuck on an old firmware and has many songs locked. 2 Tokens - 1 Song.
findings.note: Neon FM is a music/rhythm title; not in named slug list so other.

findings.name: Caribbean Cinemas (Las Catalinas)
findings.evidence_quote: Arcade is located just in the entrance of the theater to the right. Games: No games at this location. Updated 2026-04-18.
findings.note: Lobby arcade exists but no cab list or community reports of rhythm games found.

findings.name: Caribbean Cinemas (Plaza Guaynabo)
findings.evidence_quote: No games at this location. Multiple visitors listed; last update 2026-04-18 with empty inventory.
findings.note: Empty ZIv; no independent cab list found.

findings.name: Caribbean Cinemas (Plaza Prados del Sur)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (Very loud!). ITGmania (North America) Excellent sound and pads, US$1.00 for 4 songs. Perfect.
findings.note: Guitar Hero Arcade -> other; ITGmania (StepMania fork on pads) -> stepmaniax. Santa Isabel cinema arcade.

findings.name: Caribbean Cinemas (Plaza del Sol)
findings.evidence_quote: Current games only Wangan Midnight MAXIMUM TUNE (2P) and Wangan Midnight MAXIMUM TUNE 2 (2P). Comments (historical): Removed the DDR Extreme cab, and was replaced with a Pump It Up Exceed; older ITG dedicab notes not on current list.
findings.note: Rhythm cabs historically present (DDR/PIU/ITG) but 2026 inventory shows racing only. Treat as no current music games.

findings.name: Caribbean Cinemas (Ponce Towne Center)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: ITGmania (North America) Perfect. Also Wangan Midnight MAXIMUM TUNE (2P). Updated 2026-04-18.
findings.note: ITGmania listed as music game; Wangan is racing only.

findings.name: Caribbean Cinemas (The Outlet 66)
findings.evidence_quote: DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA (North America). Comment: Went there recently, it's still turned off with the majority of the cabs that used to be there removed only a few remain and DDR is the only that is turned off. Condition: Not Working.
findings.note: Cab still listed as present but powered off / not working. Count as has_games ddr with operational caveat.

findings.name: Chuck E. Cheese (Plaza Centro)
findings.evidence_quote: Arcade place for kids, there was a Pump It Up NX2, but got removed, so basically you will only see lots of kids and arcades focused on children.
findings.note: Explicit ZIv note that PIU NX2 was removed; kids redemption only now.

findings.name: Chuck E. Cheese's (Los Colobos Shopping Center)
findings.evidence_quote: Chain kids pizza/arcade in Puerto Rico (Carolina/Los Colobos). No public cab list naming rhythm titles for this branch; ZIv has empty games list.
findings.note: Unlike Caguas, no positive statement that PIU/DDR are absent here. Do not invent confirmed_none without branch-specific inventory.

findings.name: Costa Bahia Hotel and Convention Center
findings.evidence_quote: Hotel lobby mini-arcade list: Ms. Pac-Man/Galaga, Star Wars Trilogy, Venom pinball, Cruis'n Exotica, Go Go Pony, Super Bikes 2, basketball, air hockey. Comment (~2024): The bootleg games DDR Megamix and DDR Extreme Plus do not display partial credits.
findings.note: Main list has no rhythm cab; a 2-year-old comment implies bootleg DDR on some multicade. Ambiguous, so unknown rather than has_games.

findings.name: Cupey Bowling & Entertainment Center (Cupey Professional Mall)
findings.evidence_quote: Previously housed a DDR EXTREME cab at 3 songs/0.75 cents, but the arcade area has been closed and vacant post-pandemic. It is currently unknown when the arcade will reopen or if they still have the DDR cab. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Bowling venue still operates (laboleradecupey.com) but ZIv states arcade room vacant post-pandemic; no current rhythm.

findings.name: Dave & Buster's (Plaza Las Américas)
findings.evidence_quote: Doesn't have any rhythm/dance games, besides a VR game called Synth Riders. Games list shows Synth Riders Arcade twice (Perfect). Midway is mostly racing/redemption.
findings.note: Only music-class title is Synth Riders Arcade (VR rhythm) x2; slug other. No Konami/Bemani/ITG.

findings.name: Hi Score Z
findings.evidence_quote: Has 4 Pandora's Box multicades, technically DDR is available in them but you play with an arcade stick so not really recommended. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Stick-only emulated DDR on multicade is not a pad rhythm install; no dedicated music cabs.

findings.name: Holiday Inn Mayaguez & Tropical Casino
findings.evidence_quote: No games at this location. Empty visitors and pictures; last edit 2022-12-29.
findings.note: No public inventory; hotel/casino may or may not still have a game room.

findings.name: Just 4 Fun (Plaza Carolina)
findings.evidence_quote: Just 4 Fun is a playground for small children. It has a cafeteria and a video game arcade. ZIv: children's play place with an arcade room; No games at this location.
findings.note: Kids FEC with unnamed video games; no rhythm titles proven or disproven.

findings.name: Predator Gaming Center
findings.evidence_quote: Predator Gaming Center: bowling under black lights, arcade classics, neon-lit lanes, lounge. Instagram: arcade y bowling. No named rhythm titles found.
findings.note: Dorado del Mar bowling/arcade FEC opened ~2023. ZIv empty; no ITG/DDR/maimai evidence.

findings.name: Almaz
findings.evidence_quote: Information: No games anymore. Games: No games at this location. Updated 2013-08-01.
findings.note: Cinema-linked Moscow listing explicitly marked no games anymore (2013). Cinema brand may still operate; arcade portion is gone. Old evidence.

findings.name: Apel'sin
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Jungle Drummer (International). The drums and sticks in great condition. 15₽ / 1 song. Also Sea Wolf: The Next Mission.
findings.note: Jungle Drummer is a drum rhythm game -> other. Sevastopol listing from 2022; current status unverified.

findings.name: Capital Park
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Dirty Drivin', Mighty Moto, Astro Blaster only.
findings.note: Ulan-Ude Capital Cinema park: racing/shooter only on ZIv.

findings.name: Euroland
findings.evidence_quote: Website eurozone-centr.ru. Games: No games at this location. Picture uploaded; no cab inventory.
findings.note: Ulan-Ude entertainment center; ZIv stub without games.

findings.name: In The Groove 2 homemade arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Homemade ITG2 venue near B/O Amur, base У Самвела with ITG2 banner. Website vk.com/dancingitg2. Hours 09:00-23:00; confirm days in VK. Games section empty on ZIv but name/description are the machine.
findings.note: Artyom private/homemade ITG2 pad hall. No formal ZIv game row but venue is purpose-built for ITG2 (StepMania-family). Map stepmaniax.

findings.name: Ostrova (Krasnodar)
findings.evidence_quote: RC Ostrova Krasnodar Dzerzhinskogo 100: kids zones, sports machines, party hall, ice rink site mentions game machines. ZIv: No games at this location.
findings.note: Family entertainment center with generic arcade machines; no named rhythm titles found.

findings.name: People's Park
findings.evidence_quote: Ulan-Ude People's Park ZIv stub: No games at this location. Updated 2024-01-15.
findings.note: No cab list or local reports of music games found.

findings.name: Pioner Park
findings.evidence_quote: trc-pioner.ru mall park listing. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Ulan-Ude mall entertainment; empty ZIv inventory.

findings.name: PlayLab (Rostov)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Jungle Drummer - drums and sticks in good condition, LCD swap. Extensive photo set of Jungle Drummer cab. Also racing/shooters (Dirty Drivin', Super Bikes 2, Rambo, etc.).
findings.note: Well-documented 2022 visit with Jungle Drummer photos. No Bemani; slug other. Current status after ~4 years unverified.
